notes: Two runs per side, 2026-11-21, on adapter commit 4691d49 (later commits change no file the agent sees; see the README). 200-task subset, 100 per domain, stratified by hard-subset membership and topic (parity_task_ids.txt); this entry is both domains, the next two are Finance and Legal. Same agent build, model and judge on both sides: Claude Code 2.1.322, claude-haiku-5-5, judge gpt-5.6-terra (o4-mini is not served on the parity endpoint and gpt-4.1 is refused there); the endpoint reported these model names for every agent and judge call. Harbor side: Harbor 0.26.0, prbench_parity.yaml. Original side: the fork's harbor_parity/run_agent.py collects the replies and the fork's evals.py grades them (final_response_source: prefilled), at fork commit e7b4453; the fork changes no scoring code (its HARBOR_PARITY.md lists the changes). Metric: mean unclipped task score floored at 0 (mean_clipped), in percent; runs to 4 decimals. Paired per task (both runs averaged, n = 200): Harbor - original +0.0002 +/- 0.0059 (SE), correlation of per-task means 0.92 (scripts/paired_parity.py in the upload). Every task graded on both sides; no Harbor exceptions, failed judge calls or agent errors. One original-side agent run (run 1, legal-740a326c927c1ce16ffee6b8) wrote no reply; upstream sends the empty reply to the judge, which marked one criterion met (task score 0.094), while the Harbor grader scores an empty reply 0 without a judge call. Cost of the two runs: at most $202 on both sides, agent and judge. Parity files: the shared-dataset PR in parity_pr cannot take uploads while harborframework/parity-experiments is over the Hugging Face limit of 1,000,000 files (harbor-framework/adapters#129); the same adapters/prbench/ folder is at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mike-7777777/harbor-parity-experiments/tree/9fbf606835507587e205b4fc96ed034e076fa60f/adapters/prbench (pinned commit), with SHA256 checksums in manifests/prbench.sha256 at the root of that dataset.
Finance tasks of the same runs (see the first entry). Paired per task: Harbor - original -0.0018 +/- 0.0083 (SE), correlation of per-task means 0.92.
Legal tasks of the same runs (see the first entry). Paired per task: Harbor - original +0.0022 +/- 0.0084 (SE), correlation of per-task means 0.92.
